template.title: The Balloon Pet Adventure
template.summary: A kind child helps a lost balloon‑tied pet find its home in the park.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play in [[slot_place]] on sunny days.
One morning, [[slot_child]] saw a tiny [[slot_color]] balloon bobbing in the grass.
The balloon was tied to a small [[slot_pet]] that looked lost and shy.
[[slot_child]] felt a tug in the heart and wondered where the [[slot_pet]] came from.
The child almost ran home to get [[slot_toy]], but decided to stay and help.
[[slot_child]] whispered, “I will find you home,” and put a soft [[slot_snack]] on the ground.
The [[slot_pet]] sniffed the snack and followed the scent.
Together they walked past the fountain and the big oak tree.
A friendly [[slot_neighbor]] noticed the balloon and asked, “Are you looking for someone?”
[[slot_child]] explained the situation, and [[slot_neighbor]] remembered seeing a [[slot_pet]] with a blue collar near the playground.
They all followed the trail of the blue collar.
At the playground, a little boy waved and said, “That’s my [[slot_pet]]!” He laughed and thanked [[slot_child]].
[[slot_child]] felt warm inside, like a sunrise.
The balloon floated up and disappeared into the sky, leaving a bright memory.
From then on, [[slot_child]] always kept a snack for friends in the park.
And every day, the park smelled of adventure and kindness.
